lines: It helped keep the wolves from making a story of me. That's enough praise.
It did the job when fear was loud. That's praise enough.
Good gear earns trust the moment trouble tests it.
Let me see that. The flocks and weather tell a story if you know where to look.
That has seen use. Not enough to panic, but enough to respect it.
A small flaw becomes a loud problem when trouble starts moving.
Keep your blanket ready. Most people notice damage after it matters.
This is still serviceable, but do not treat that as permission to be reckless.
I would fix that before night. Night has a talent for finding weak spots.
Good equipment should feel boring. Exciting equipment is usually breaking.
